title: Introduction to Machine Learning
description: Comprehensive foundation in supervised learning, model complexity, regularization, and generalization evaluation.

plos.text: Computing & Engineering Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics and computing fundamentals.
Problem Analysis: Identify, formulate, and analyze complex engineering and computing problems.

clos.text: Explain fundamental concepts of model complexity, bias-variance tradeoff, and generalization.
Analyze and diagnose overfitting and underfitting using training and validation metrics.
Apply regularization and validation strategies to mitigate overfitting in predictive models.
